dedupeText: retro 1980s pop portrait 80s pop geometric typography color block fashion checkered pattern voluminous hair off the shoulder sweater subject occupies the central and lower left thirds of the frame typography is positioned in the upper right to balance the subject s pose checkered patterns on the clothing echo the vertical border element vibrant primary and secondary colors in the patches contrast with the neutral background combine 80s studio portraiture with memphis style geometric graphics and high contrast patterned knitwear to create a nostalgic pop aesthetic

retrievalProfile.description: A vibrant 1980s studio portrait featuring bold geometric typography, high-contrast knitwear, and a moody, desaturated background.

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a female subject with voluminous dark hair, wearing a black and white off-the-shoulder sweater with colorful geometric patches and checkered accents, set against a muted grey-purple background with stylized geometric text in the upper right.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject occupies the central and lower-left thirds of the frame
Typography is positioned in the upper right to balance the subject's pose
Checkered patterns on the clothing echo the vertical border element
Vibrant primary and secondary colors in the patches contrast with the neutral background
coreInvariants: Geometric, multi-colored lettering with black outlines

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is seated, filling approximately 70% of the vertical frame, leaning slightly to the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and large hoop earring serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the subject's face, down the diagonal of the shoulder, across the colorful sweater patches, and up to the graphic text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Muted, solid-color negative space in the upper left and right corners provides breathing room for the busy patterns.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Primary yellow, purple, and teal (patches and typography)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in small geometric details against a low-saturation, mid-value background.

letterConstructionRules: Triangular 'A' shapes with no crossbar or a modified geometric block
Heavy black outlines on all characters
Internal color blocking with horizontal divisions
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' is rendered as an equilateral triangle with a floating horizontal bar
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single decorative display face used for impact.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the geometric base for triangular modifications
Captures the 80s graphic design language accurately

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a woman with 80s permed hair, wearing a black and white off-the-shoulder sweater with checkered trim and colorful geometric patches, against a solid muted purple-grey backdrop.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom geometric triangular lettering in the upper right corner with thick black outlines and internal color-blocking in teal, yellow, and purple.

verificationChecks: Checkered pattern is present on clothing and border
Background is a solid, muted color

adjustableVariables: Specific geometric shapes in the typography
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Exact brand logos or text content
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the off-the-shoulder silhouette is maintained
Verify the typography is geometric and outlined
Confirm the presence of checkered patterns
Check that the background remains muted and non-distracting
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [80s studio portraiture] with [Memphis-style geometric graphics] and [high-contrast patterned knitwear] to create a nostalgic pop aesthetic.
